video_complete.description: Emitted when video playback finishes; captures the completed viewing session with content and completion status.

select_content.description: Emitted when user selects content to play from discovery surfaces; captures content and selection context.

video_progress.description: Emitted during playback at regular intervals; captures playhead position and active quality tier.

video_start.description: Emitted when video playback begins; captures session start and player configuration details.

exception.description: Emitted when a playback error occurs; captures error type, code, severity, and affected system component.

view_item_list.description: Emitted when user views content lists or recommendations; captures list metadata and contained items.

Content Genre Popularity.description: Emitted during genre-based content interactions; captures genre engagement and selection data.

media.description: Data structure containing media playback attributes; records quality tier and streaming configuration.
